description.value: The frozen front of the youngest cryovolcanic flow, a lobe eighty kilometres wide that stopped moving about four thousand years ago and is still warm at depth. Vent pockets along it hold liquid for decades at a time. The station sits on the margin because the margin is flat, not because anybody chose it on the science.

notes.value: The flat ground was chosen by a pilot with fuel for one approach, and the science has been fitting itself around that decision for forty years.
